articles.headline: Meta Adjusts Instagram Algorithm in India to Curb Harmful Content
articles.brief: Following government scrutiny, Meta has tuned its Instagram recommendation systems in India to limit the visibility of suggestive and violent content, specifically targeting Reels and suggested posts from unfollowed accounts.

articles.headline: US Electronic Spy Agency NSA Suffers Major Classified Network Outage
articles.brief: The United States National Security Agency experienced a significant outage affecting a classified computer network used for internal communications and daily operational functions, triggering widespread cyberattack concerns.

articles.headline: India Considers Limits on Leveraged Stock Bets to Curb Market Volatility
articles.brief: Indian authorities are reportedly exploring measures to cap leveraged trading in equities to manage rising market volatility, following a period of intense trading activity and substantial retail participation.

articles.headline: Icra Predicts Resilient 7.5% GDP Growth for India in Q2
articles.brief: Rating agency Icra forecasts India's economic growth to remain steady at 7.5% in the second quarter of FY27, backed by robust manufacturing and services activities despite agricultural and monsoon headwinds.

articles.headline: Quad Nations Announce First Joint Maritime Military Exercise for 2027
articles.brief: Gathering in Manila, Quad leaders announced plans to conduct their first joint military exercises featuring maritime patrol aircraft in March 2027, sending a strong strategic signal regarding regional stability.

articles.headline: Delhi Assembly Set to Hold Winter Session from December 18 to 23
articles.brief: The Delhi government announced that the upcoming winter session of the legislative assembly will take place between December 18 and 23, focusing heavily on regional development and welfare programs.

articles.headline: Amazon Commits Fresh $7 Billion for Green Energy Projects in India
articles.brief: Amazon has announced a multi-billion-dollar investment scaling up its renewable energy footprint in India, introducing four new utility-scale wind and solar initiatives with a combined generation capacity of 934 megawatts.

articles.headline: General Motors Plans 20% Increase in Factory Robotics Amid Rising Costs
articles.brief: General Motors is accelerating its automation strategy by implementing a 20% expansion in factory robotics to counter mounting labor expenses and increasing operational pressures across manufacturing lines.

articles.headline: MS Dhoni Officially Retires from IPL, Ending Legendary Cricket Career
articles.brief: Iconic cricketer MS Dhoni has confirmed his retirement from the Indian Premier League, concluding a storied tenure that established Chennai Super Kings as one of the tournament's most dominant franchises.

articles.headline: Sellas Reports Positive Vaccine Trial Results for Blood Cancer Patients
articles.brief: Sellas Life Sciences announced that its experimental cancer vaccine significantly extended overall survival in clinical trials for blood cancer patients, causing company shares to surge following the data release.

articles.headline: Russian Military Transport Plane Crashes in Siberia, Killing 19
articles.brief: An An-12 Russian military transport aircraft crashed in an unpopulated region near Kemerovo in Siberia, resulting in the deaths of all 19 people on board, according to the country's defense ministry.

articles.headline: LPG Tanker Sinks off Bulgarian Coast in the Black Sea
articles.brief: A liquefied petroleum gas tanker has reportedly sunk off the coast of Bulgaria in the Black Sea, prompting regional rescue operations and environmental monitoring to address potential hazard risks.

articles.headline: Chandrayaan-3 Discovers Three Distinct Structural Layers in Lunar Soil
articles.brief: Analyzing data gathered by the mission, scientists confirmed that Chandrayaan-3 has identified three distinct compositional layers in the Moon's regolith, providing vital insights for future lunar exploration and habitat construction.

articles.headline: UK Extradites US Soldier Implicated in Alleged Russian Espionage
articles.brief: British authorities have transferred detained U.S. Army Lieutenant Colonel Brandon Tyner back to the United States after he was accused of involvement in classified intelligence leaks related to Russia.
